run_f_gold: run f_gold with two strings to compute the length of their longest common subsequence
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize the space-optimized LCS algorithm that uses a 2-row DP table instead of a full matrix
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function for correctness of the LCS dynamic programming recurrence and boundary conditions
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return the actual LCS string instead of just its length
